question: Does the metadata-frozen tenth family supply three reference-memory views, a unique adjacent query pair and a same-scene sibling before RGB or model access?

reference_memory.vacancy_fill: If the positive-marginal greedy portfolio stops at two, fill exactly one remaining source-admitted reference by maximum minimum camera-to-target angle; ties use visible vertices, short-side fraction, depth-visible ratio, then earlier frame.

query_pair.selection: Among distinct source-admitted target views at gap at most one, maximize minimum visible target vertices, then total visible target vertices, minimum short-side fraction, minimum depth-visible ratio and deterministic earlier frames.

same_scene_sibling.selection: Use the first different door or doorframe instance with an admitted view; choose its maximum-visible view with fixed quality ties.

next_action.evaluable: Freeze the three references and two unique adjacent queries, then run the unchanged proposal roster and temporal-scale vacancy rule once.
next_action.not_evaluable: Retain the source result and do not open RGB or call GroundingDINO, SAM2 or DINOv2 for this family.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, target, source hashes, view admission, reference vacancy fill, adjacent-pair selection or sibling rule
open RGB or call a model before source result
change temporal link IoU 0.5, scale penalty 0.05, link score, deterministic ties, preserved contributors, vacancy-only insertion, IoU gate or maximum set size three
replace a source-inadequate family using RGB/model outcomes
claim_boundary: This gate can establish only fresh-family geometry/depth reachability for a three-reference and adjacent-two-query replay. It is not RGB/model evidence, temporal-scale vacancy confirmation, top-one localization, exact-instance binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
